summary: When several CSS rules match the same element, the browser must pick one value for each property. Each paragraph here matches a different set of rules and says which one wins.
notes: The second paragraph has class="note", so it matches both p and .note.
The last two elements are inside <section class="club-news"> to show inheritance.
Read each line, then find the matching rules in the CSS pane.
pitfall: Adding an id to an element only to beat another rule. It works, but the next change then needs an even stronger selector.
